commands.name: build

options.name: --app-dispatch-events
options.description: Application layer: dispatch each domain event an  aggregate recorded after the transaction commits, via the emitted  IDomainEventDispatcher contract (you supply the implementation).

options.name: --app-handler-result
options.description: Application layer: what a command handler returns,  void (default), aggregate (the loaded, mutated aggregate root), or readModel (a  read-model projection of it).

options.name: --app-mapping
options.description: Application layer: DTO/read-model mapping strategy,  plain (default) or mapperly.

options.name: --app-mediatr
options.description: Application layer: emit the MediatR request/handler  shape with validation + transaction pipeline behaviors (default: plain  handlers).

options.name: --app-not-found
options.description: Application layer: how a handler treats a missing  aggregate, throw (default), nullable (return null, e.g. for a 404), or result  (return a Result<T>).

options.name: --config
options.description: Read defaults (target/out) from this koine.config  instead of discovering one.

options.name: --docs
options.description: Also write living documentation (Mermaid-in-Markdown)  to this directory (independent of --target).

options.name: --glossary
options.description: Also write a Markdown glossary to this file  (independent of --target).

options.name: --layers
options.description: Comma-separated C# layers to emit: domain (default),  application, infrastructure, api (ASP.NET endpoints; implies application).  Opt-in layers imply domain. Omit for the default domain-only output.

options.name: --out
options.description: Directory to write generated files into; omit to only  parse/validate.

options.name: --reference-only
options.description: Emit a reference-assembly-style contract surface: all  type/member signatures, interfaces and contracts, with implementation bodies  stripped to stubs.

options.name: --regex-match-timeout-ms
options.description: Override the C# regex match timeout (ms) for this  invocation; wins over targets.csharp.regexMatchTimeoutMs. Must be a positive  integer.

options.name: --source-maps
options.description: Emit source-map debug info linking generated code back to the .koi source (C# #line directives; TypeScript *.ts.map sidecars).

options.name: --target
options.description: Output target: csharp (default), typescript, python,  php, rust, glossary, docs, asyncapi, or openapi.

options.name: --warnings-as-errors
options.description: Promote every warning to an error (after any  diagnostics.<CODE> config override).

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: The .koi file or directory to compile (a directory is  compiled as one model).

commands.description: Compile a .koi model and (optionally) emit code.

commands.name: check

options.name: --baseline
options.description: The previously published model to compare against (or  a `baseline` key in koine.config).

options.name: --config
options.description: Read defaults from this koine.config instead of  discovering one.

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: The current model (.koi file or directory) to compare  against the baseline.

commands.description: Flag breaking changes vs a published baseline.

commands.name: coverage

options.name: --config
options.description: Read defaults (target) from this koine.config instead  of discovering one.

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit the report as stable JSON instead of the  human-readable summary.

options.name: --target
options.description: Output target to measure coverage against: csharp  (default), typescript, python, php, rust.

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: The .koi file or directory to compile (a directory is  compiled as one model).

commands.description: Report which declared types a target emits (non-zero exit  on gaps).

options.name: --check
options.description: Do not write; exit non-zero if any file is unformatted or unparseable.

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: The .koi file or directory to format.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite existing domain.koi / koine.config /  README.md.

arguments.name: dir
arguments.description: Directory to scaffold into (default: the current  directory).

commands.name: mcp

options.name: --host
options.description: HTTP bind address (default 127.0.0.1, loopback only).  Used only with --http.

options.name: --http
options.description: Serve over HTTP (Streamable HTTP/SSE) instead of  stdio.

options.name: --port
options.description: HTTP port (default 0 = OS-assigned). Used only with  --http.

commands.description: MCP server exposing the compiler tools to AI agents  (stdio, or --http by URL).

commands.name: sandbox-landlock
commands.description: Install a Landlock ruleset and exec the given command  (internal).

commands.name: scenario-exec
commands.description: Run one scenario against the model's emitted code  (stdio protocol; internal).
